purpose: Execute the uploaded multi-asset/multi-timeframe mandate in bounded increments. First increment audits tracked inventory and critical paths, maps real coverage, generalizes corrected ATR to explicit bar durations, and compares fixed hypotheses without tuning for positive returns. Full production/shared-portfolio mandate remains separate.
market_identity_scope: Reuse prior verified provider IDs/pool metadata with explicit historical fee and issuer/migration uncertainty. No current survivor list is declared point-in-time unbiased. Other requested assets have NOT_ACQUIRED status, not invented pools/history.

data_plan.reuse: Hash-check cached1h ETH/cbBTC and cached4h all five assets. Each evaluation selects ONE complete source, never silently splices providers or fills gaps.
data_plan.request_policy: Documented public JSONL endpoint only, one per request,30s timeout,3s spacing, no credentials/paidservice/retries/redirects. Stop remaining requests to this provider on401/403/429. Do not retry previously denied oldETH history.
data_plan.resampling: Only downsample from equal-or-finer divisible intervals; first open,max high,min low,last close,sum volume. An aggregate cell needs every expected native row. Missing source cells remain missing. Weekly bars Monday00UTC; all others UTC midnight multiples. No5mdata synthesized from4hprices.
data_plan.source_priority: For each whole window including warmup: prefer1hcache for>=1h,4hcache for compatible multiples, thennew5m. Daily5yearBNB source is considered for>=1day. Native4h source is the regression check for old4h adapter; report any resolution-source differences rather than confusing them with strategy changes.
data_plan.future_candles: Discard source end-boundary rows; accept only fully completed intervals before frozen end. Hashes prove identity not market authenticity.

hypothesis_scope: Two fixed ATR/veto families under2parameter clocks; no parameter optimization. Same120bars at5m and12h represent different economic horizons, so report bar-clock separately. At4h bothclocks coincide: retain case identity but deduplicate execution, never count duplicate evidence.
warmup: max(entry+1,atr+1,atr+volref+1 if veto); dynamic by explicit duration. No shortening for missing source history. Unavailable combinations are SKIPPED_INSUFFICIENT_DATA, not zero profit.
risk_execution: Reuse corrected payoff.Policy with5%fraction convention and existing ATRstop/trailing,20%equity entry budget,25notional cap,10reserve,2entryintents/day,3%daily and10%drawdown triggers. Change only timing/features. Closed-bar signals execute next-open, notintrabar guaranteed stops. Scheduled terminal exit at finalbaropen is predeclared and disclosed. Daily controls on12h/daily/weekly bars are sampled atdecision times, not a truecontinuousdaily hardcap. No leverage/funding.
cost_scope: All four are stated nonzero sensitivities, not supported universal upper/lower bounds or authenticated historical full cost. Unknown gas/MEV/issuer parity not assumed covered. Full execution qualification remainsUNKNOWN. Additional1USD/month charged to cash atmonthlyboundaries will be evaluated on finalists only in a separate announced future run, not silently applied as an already-implementedfeature.
evaluation: Coverage grid first; first bounded development batch includes all registered valid cases until a documented resourcebudget. Maximum250000bar evaluations per individual case,4096cases per invocation,oneprocess/BLASthread. Finer5year data may exceed budget and needs separate reviewed batch; never substitute shorterwindow. Per-run IDs bind code/config/data/environment; completed result hashes verified on resume; duplicate4hclocks reuse results with labels. No liveprocess left running.
selection: No best model declared by maximizing allseenwindows. Compare matchedasset/window/cost first. Report candidate qualification using positive mid/stress continuous12month AND later6month on the same pool, >=10closedcycles in12month, no drawdownhalt, and no source/accounting faults. These are research screens only; no globally unseenholdout or fundedapproval claimed. Report all negative and insufficient cases.
metrics: Netaccountgrowth, calendar geometricdaily,closeDD,recovery duration, tradecount,payoff,PF,expectancy,R,MAE/MFE,fees,exposure,turnover, concentration and full daily/monthly/yearly marks when resolution permits. Do not create precise daily marks fromweeklycandles. Include cash/20percenthold on selected matched panels; no sumofindependent100accounts.
